description: This file defines a PHP class ReportingMethodController that extends AbstractVueController, handling reporting method configurations in the OrangeHRM PIM plugin. It manages dependencies, prepares Vue components, and interacts with ReportingMethodConfigurationService.

classes.name: ReportingMethodController
classes.description: Controller class for managing reporting methods in the OrangeHRM PIM plugin, extending the AbstractVueController and generating Vue components for reporting methods.

methods.name: getReportingMethodService
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns an instance of ReportingMethodConfigurationService.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the Vue component with reporting method data before rendering.
